apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Changed
- Album pages show all their songs at once, the ones that aren't here yet among them, instead of yours first and the rest a moment later. An album starts loading when you point at or touch it, so it's usually there as you open it. If finding the missing songs takes long, yours show after a couple of seconds and the rest join them.

Fixed
- Songs Tuna filed itself stayed "on no album Lidarr has" when Lidarr has their album from another source (Deezer, Discogs, through Tubifarry's MetaMix): Tuna only matched albums by their MusicBrainz id. Now also by name, among the artist's albums in Lidarr. Press Look again once after updating to check them all now (else each is checked within a day).
- Covers from Soulseek of another album: a copy ripped from a compilation brought the compilation's cover with it. Now a copy keeps its cover only if it comes from the album asked for (its album tag says so, else the folder it was in). Songs Tuna filed before are checked once.

To update: the server (pull the new image). The apps need nothing new.
